info.title: ReleaseOS public API
info.summary: Releases, gates, approvals, calendar, deployments and analytics.
info.description: Workspace-scoped and role-checked exactly like the application: a token acts as the person who made it (or last rotated it), in the token's workspace, and its scopes narrow what that person's role allows. Status changes are service actions (`:advance`, `:complete`, `:certify`, …); nothing sets a status column. Writes that change a record need `If-Match` carrying the record's `version`. A POST may carry an `Idempotency-Key`; a repeat of a successful request returns the stored result. Versioning and deprecation: docs/API_VERSIONING.md.

get.summary: Who the token acts as: the person, their role in the workspace and the workspace

400.description: The request could not be read (a bad cursor, limit or Idempotency-Key, or a malformed body).

401.description: The token is missing, unknown, revoked or expired.

403.description: The token lacks the `read` scope (`ScopeDenied`, `requiredScope` names it), or the person it acts as lacks the role the operation needs (`RoleDenied`).

404.description: The record does not exist in the token's workspace.

429.description: Too many requests for the token or its workspace; wait `Retry-After` seconds. `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining` and `X-RateLimit-Reset` are on every response.

bearerToken.description: An API token (`rt_…`) from Admin, API tokens. Shown once when it is made or rotated.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` with the same filters to get the next page; null on the last page.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details. `guard` names the rule that refused the request (it is the same name the internal API uses, `DbRule` for a database rule, `ScopeDenied`, `RateLimited` and so on) and `message` repeats `detail`; members such as `items`, `failures` and, on a 409, `current` (the row as it is now) are kept as the internal API returns them.

requiredScope.description: On a 403 ScopeDenied: the scope the operation needs.

current.description: On a 409 VersionConflict: the row as it is now.
